name: Raspberry Pi desktop (Pi 3, 4, 400)
description: An SD-card image for the Raspberry Pi 3/4/400 (64-bit): Xfce with LightDM, Firefox, Thonny and GPIO tools. Write it with dd or Raspberry Pi Imager.

35-remote-access.list.title: Remote access
35-remote-access.list.comment: Log in over the network (ssh pi.local). Add your key in sysconf.txt on the boot partition.
